title: Sliceroute mitigation and staged recovery playbook for cross-environment model regression
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Problem statement: Recent model rollout to multiple environments (hosted + dedicated pools + private VPCs) produced a subtle quality regression for a small tenant slice. Existing runbooks either do a full rollback or a tenant cutoff; both are costly for availability and customer confidence.

Goal: Implement a documented, testable 'sliceroute' mitigation pattern and staged recovery playbook that safely isolates affected tenant slices, reconciles KV/prefix cache inconsistencies, and provides a fast path to full rollback if quality does not recover. Playbook must be usable by SRE/triage engineers and include automation hooks for common environments (hosted API, Dedicated GPU pool, Private VPC agent).

Scope: Playbook covers detection -> isolation -> verification -> staged traffic reintroduction -> rollback path. Excludes long-term scheduler/kernel improvements (separate follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Runbook executes reproducibly across hosted/dedicated/private with step-by-step checklists
Automated sliceroute orchestration (traffic steering + pinning) completes in <5 minutes with audit events emitted
KV/prefix cache reconciliation procedure reduces mismatch errors to <1% on verified slices after rewarm
Sentinel prompt quality checks return <2% regression rate for affected slice before full restore
Playbook documented with runbook links, incident communication templates, and a tested rollback trigger (manual + automated)
steps: 1) Triage: confirm regression via production-sentinel dashboard and tie to rollout window. Collect request traces and top-failing tenants.
2) Identify slice: compute tenant-slice set by traffic fingerprint (namespace + tenant_id) and map to deployment targets (hosted region, dedicated pool id, private agent id).
3) Pin/Drain: apply sliceroute: pin unaffected tenants to current model variant, drain affected slice to a warm fallback variant (smaller context or previous checkpoint) where available.
4) KV cache reconciliation: execute ordered KV rewarm + prefix cache invalidation on nodes serving affected slice (scripted, with idempotency checks).

5) Sentinel validation: run a curated prompt set (sourced from incident regression suite) against drained slice on fallback variant and comparison variant; evaluate delta metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/semantic-similarity and hallucination indicators).

6) Staged reintroduction: progressively shift traffic back to primary variant in 10% increments per 5-minute window while monitoring latency, error-rates, and sentinel regressions. Abort to rollback if thresholds exceed guardrails.

7) Rollback path: if recovery fails at any stage, execute full rollback orchestration (variant pin across environments + global cache purge + customer comms), and create postmortem with RCA metadata for follow-up.
8) Communication: use templated customer-facing message with current status, ETA for fix, and recommended customer mitigations (API pin guidance or temporary feature flags).
9) Post-incident: collect telemetry, add failing items to regression test suite, and schedule automation work to reduce manual steps (follow-up EPIC).
comments: 2026-03-01 - Ava Patel: Initial triage. Canary failure detected at 2026-03-01T03:12Z. Affected ~1.7% of global traffic concentrated in eu-west-1 hosted pool and a dedicated GPU pool (ded-04). Opening ENG-91527 to formalize recovery pattern.

2026-03-02 - Diego Ramos: Investigation shows KV-cache divergence and prefix-embedding mismatch for the new kernel selection path. Repro steps and traces uploaded to incident timeline. Decided to avoid immediate global rollback to preserve capacity for unaffected tenants.

2026-03-03 - Priya Menon (SRE): Run initial sliceroute experiment on a synthetic tenant-slice in staging. Verified traffic pinning + drain logic works end-to-end. Observed that full prefix cache purge caused short latency spike; changed approach to ordered node rewarm.
2026-03-05 - Product (Liam O'Connor): Approved customer comms template; requested conservative thresholds on staged reintroduction. Added label 'customer-communication-required'.
2026-03-08 - Diego Ramos: Implemented automation scripts for KV rewarm and node-targeted prefix invalidation (PR #1298). Need review from infra and privacy teams for private agent execution path.

2026-03-10 - Security (Marta Li): Quick security read: private VPC agent hooks require explicit HSM token retrieval; added checklist item to ensure operator has temporary credentials. No blocking issues.

2026-03-12 - QA (Jonas Schmidt): End-to-end dry run executed in preprod with booked monitors. Sentinel suite shows 0.9% regression on one sentinel prompt; acceptable per agreement. Moving to pilot on 2 low-impact tenant slices tomorrow.
